title: Survive a lethal swing: the wall has to stand in front of the trampler
briefing: P1 is at 5 life and P2 attacks with Colossal Dreadmaw (6/6 trample) and Kalonian Tusker (3/3). P1 has Wall of Omens (0/4) and Llanowar Elves (1/1) to block with. Only two block assignments survive. The intuitive blocks (wall on the smaller creature, or chumping the Dreadmaw with the Elves) are lethal because of trample.

reference.analysis: Unblocked, the attack deals 9 to a player at 5. The Dreadmaw tramples: blocked by the 0/4 wall it still pushes 2 through, blocked by the 1/1 Elves it pushes 5 through. Wall on Dreadmaw and Elves on Tusker takes 2 (P1 ends at 3; both blockers die). Both blockers on the Dreadmaw takes 1 trample plus 3 from the unblocked Tusker (P1 ends at 1; both blockers die). Every other assignment takes at least 5 and P1 is dead: wall on Tusker with Elves on Dreadmaw takes 5, wall on Dreadmaw alone takes 2 + 3 = 5.

options.label: Wall blocks Dreadmaw, Elves chump the Tusker
options.why: Takes only the 2 trample damage and ends at 3 life. Both blockers die either way; this keeps the most life.

options.label: Double-block the Dreadmaw
options.why: Survives at 1 life, but takes 2 more damage than necessary for the same two dead blockers.

otherwise.why: P1 takes at least 5 damage at 5 life and is eliminated.
